mapper.sql:
FROM student_internship_status sis JOIN student_users su ON su.id = sis.student_id JOIN company_users company ON company.id = #{companyId} LEFT JOIN internship_stage_assignment assignment ON assignment.id = ( SELECT MAX(current_assignment.id) FROM internship_stage_assignment current_assignment WHERE current_assignment.student_id = sis.student_id AND current_assignment.current_flag = 1 ) LEFT JOIN major m ON m.id = su.major_id LEFT JOIN class cls ON cls.id = su.class_id LEFT JOIN position p ON p.id = sis.position_id WHERE su.status = 1 AND sis.status = 3 AND sis.company_confirm_status = 1 AND (assignment.id IS NULL OR assignment.status = 'IN_PROGRESS') AND (sis.internship_start_time IS NULL OR sis.internship_start_time <= NOW()) AND (sis.internship_end_time IS NULL OR sis.internship_end_time > NOW()) AND ( (sis.company_id = company.id AND (assignment.id IS NULL OR assignment.company_id = company.id)) OR ( sis.company_id IS NULL AND assignment.company_id IS NULL AND assignment.source_type = 'SELF_PRACTICE' AND LOWER(TRIM(assignment.company_name)) = LOWER(TRIM(company.company_name)) AND LOWER(TRIM(sis.company_name)) = LOWER(TRIM(company.company_name)) AND company.status = 1 AND company.audit_status = 1 AND COALESCE(company.recall_status, 0) != 1 AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM company_users duplicate_company WHERE duplicate_company.id != company.id AND duplicate_company.status = 1 AND duplicate_company.audit_status = 1 AND COALESCE(duplicate_company.recall_status, 0) != 1 AND LOWER(TRIM(duplicate_company.company_name)) = LOWER(TRIM(company.company_name)) ) ) )
AND ( su.name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR su.student_user_id LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR COALESCE(NULLIF(p.position_name, ''), sis.position_name, assignment.position_name) LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') )
mapper.select:
SELECT su.id AS student_id, assignment.id AS placement_id, COALESCE(NULLIF(su.name, ''), sis.student_name) AS student_name, su.student_user_id AS student_number, COALESCE(NULLIF(su.grade, ''), sis.grade) AS grade, COALESCE(NULLIF(m.name, ''), sis.major_name) AS major_name, COALESCE(NULLIF(cls.name, ''), sis.class_name) AS class_name, COALESCE(NULLIF(su.phone, ''), sis.contact_phone) AS phone, COALESCE(NULLIF(su.email, ''), sis.email) AS email, COALESCE(NULLIF(p.position_name, ''), sis.position_name, assignment.position_name) AS position_name, COALESCE(assignment.source_type, 'JOB_APPLICATION') AS source_type, sis.internship_start_time, sis.internship_end_time
ORDER BY sis.internship_start_time DESC, su.id DESC LIMIT #{pageSize} OFFSET #{offset}
